title: Design System: 港股證據研究室

display.purpose: Two-line cover invitation; 42–64px desktop, intermediate clamps at 1100px and 950px, a 32–43px clamp at 700px, and 29px at 400px.

headline.purpose: Research and indicator subject introductions; 32px at 700px and below.

index-headline.purpose: The research index; 42px at 700px and below.

reading-headline.purpose: Long-form article title; 32px with 1.6 leading at 700px and below.

section-headline.purpose: Shared page sections; 27px at 700px and below.

article-title.purpose: Titles in open article lists; 24px at 700px and below.

article-section.purpose: Headings within long-form prose; 25px at 700px and below.

body.purpose: Lab Sans shared base; compact tool layouts may retain their own denser sizes.

reading-body.purpose: 17px, 2.1-leading long-form prose; 16px and 2 leading at 700px and below.

reading-intro.purpose: Lab Serif opening paragraph; 19px at 700px and below.

reading-deck.purpose: Sans-serif article summary beneath the title; 16px at 700px and below.

label.purpose: Visible search, filter and tool labels; the desktop navigation shares this size and weight.

action.purpose: Shared site action and text-link role; cover actions have contextual overrides.

metadata.purpose: Article category, date and reading time; plain information, not approval badges.

code.purpose: Retained system monospace stack for code and technical notation.

shadows.name: default-surface
shadows.purpose: Final shared surface token and named editorial panels.

shadows.name: open-navigation
shadows.purpose: Grouped navigation floating above the page.

shadows.name: retained-base-card
shadows.purpose: Underlying Card compatibility style where a named editorial override does not apply.

shadows.name: retained-base-button
shadows.purpose: Underlying Button compatibility style; shared site actions explicitly remove this shadow.

motion.name: cover-arrival
motion.purpose: Visible photographic arrival from scale(1.06), opacity .82 to scale(1), opacity 1; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: surface-feedback
motion.purpose: Indicator background and topic colour transitions.

motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Existing button colour, border, transform and shadow feedback; the base Button retains active scale(.98).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Non-essential transition and animation duration; smooth scrolling becomes auto and animation iterations become one.

components.name: Primary site action
components.description: Ultramarine reading and learning action, with shared site overrides applied.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;height:44px;width:fit-content;padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:100px;box-shadow:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK",sans-serif);font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#3538b8);outline-offset:5px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--bg,#f2f1f7),0 0 0 4px var(--primary,#3538b8)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition-duration:.01ms}}.ds-primary{background:var(--primary,#3538b8);color:var(--surface,#ffffff)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-strong,#272983)}

components.css: .ds-cover-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;padding:24px;background:var(--primary,#3538b8)}.ds-cover-actions a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:50px;padding:12px 22px;border:0;border-radius:100px;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK",sans-serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:20px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:none;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out}.ds-cover-main{background:var(--citron,#e6ee92);color:var(--ink,#1b1c34)}.ds-cover-main:hover{background:#f3fac0}.ds-cover-actions .ds-cover-secondary{border:1px solid #b0b1eb;background:transparent;color:var(--surface,#ffffff)}.ds-cover-secondary:hover{background:#4a4dc8}.ds-cover-actions a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--citron,#e6ee92);outline-offset:5px}.ds-cover-actions a:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-cover-actions{gap:12px}.ds-cover-actions a{min-height:46px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:13px}}@media(max-width:400px){.ds-cover-actions{gap:10px}.ds-cover-actions a{padding-inline:14px;font-size:12px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cover-actions a{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.css: .ds-indicator{background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--ink,#1b1c34);border:0;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK",sans-serif);transition:background-color .18s ease}.ds-indicator:hover{background:#e9e7f6}.ds-indicator-head{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:28px 28px 16px}.ds-indicator h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--reading-serif,"Lab Serif","Noto Serif HK",serif);font-size:24px;line-height:1.6;font-weight:600}.ds-indicator-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.ds-indicator-meta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border:0;border-radius:100px;background:var(--surface-soft,#efedf8);color:var(--primary-strong,#272983);padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;font-weight:500}.ds-indicator-body{display:grid;gap:16px;padding:0 28px 28px}.ds-indicator a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:2px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.8;color:var(--primary-strong,#272983);text-decoration:none}.ds-indicator a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--primary,#3538b8);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-indicator-head{padding:24px 24px 14px}.ds-indicator-body{padding:0 24px 24px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-indicator{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Evidence Pipeline
components.description: Subject-header teaching sequence; the home variant is an open rail documented in DESIGN.md.
components.css: .ds-evidence{margin:0;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--primary,#3538b8);color:var(--surface,#ffffff);border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:28px;box-shadow:none;font-family:var(--font-sans,"Lab Sans","Noto Sans HK",sans-serif);line-height:1.65}.ds-evidence figcaption{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #7476d5;padding-bottom:12px}.ds-evidence figcaption strong{font-family:var(--reading-serif,"Lab Serif","Noto Serif HK",serif);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;text-align:right}.ds-evidence ol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.55rem;list-style:none;margin:1.5rem 0 0;padding:0}.ds-evidence li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:.55rem;padding:1rem 0;border-top:1px solid #7476d5}.ds-evidence li>span{font-family:var(--reading-serif,"Lab Serif","Noto Serif HK",serif);font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:var(--citron,#e6ee92)}.ds-evidence li div{display:grid}.ds-evidence li strong{font-size:15px}.ds-evidence small{color:#e5e5ff;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-evidence{padding:24px}}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-evidence ol{gap:.2rem 1rem}}@media(max-width:560px){.ds-evidence figcaption{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.ds-evidence figcaption strong{text-align:left}}

narrative.overview:
A contemporary Hong Kong museum journal applied to financial learning. Ultramarine fields, lavender paper, midnight ink and a restrained citron accent give the library an authored identity. Locally served Hong Kong serif headlines carry the reading voice; measured sans-serif text keeps navigation, explanations and tools direct.

The system shifts density with the task: broad colour fields introduce a subject, open ruled rows support browsing, a bounded column supports sustained reading, and compact panels support calculation. Sources, teaching diagrams and qualifications retain their own meaning. Architectural imagery supplies atmosphere without standing in for market evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Ultramarine and citron on cool lavender paper.
Self-hosted Hong Kong serif headings and sans-serif reading text.
Square editorial fields, softly cornered functional panels and pill actions.
Open article rows, useful teaching geometry and clearly separated tool results.
Sources and limitations remain available without repetitive production notices.

rules.name: The Meaningful Color Rule
rules.body: Color supports a written label or explanation; it never establishes review, source quality or risk on its own.

rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with the title, introduction, section heading, body and caption. Put learning-step roles below their headings as plain text, and use numbering only when the order carries meaning.

rules.name: The Content Measure Rule
rules.body: Give long articles a bounded reading measure; let research grids and comparison tools use the wider shell when the task needs it.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Use section dividers and spacing inside an article; do not wrap every paragraph or evidence block in another raised card.

dos: **Do** extend the ultramarine, lavender-paper and citron identity using the documented Lab Serif and Lab Sans roles.
**Do** shift density to suit reading, browsing or calculation while preserving the established content and behaviour.
**Do** keep actions, labels, source links, text contrast and keyboard focus clear at every viewport.
**Do** preserve distinctions between historical evidence, teaching examples and assumptions.
**Do** retain raster provenance, font licences, meaningful figure descriptions and reduced-motion support.
donts: **Don't** use fake market charts, profit promises or invented human-review credentials.
**Don't** treat a status colour, check icon or high backtest metric as proof of reliability.
**Don't** turn article paragraphs into nested cards or repeat decorative category eyebrows.
**Don't** add section numbers where there is no informative sequence.
**Don't** use the fictional architectural cover as evidence of a real location, event or market result.
